tldr: Jupiter in the 11th house: growth becomes personal through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
body:
With Jupiter in the 11th house, this part of you expands through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans. Jupiter describes growth, faith, appetite, opportunity, generosity, and the need for a wider view. In practice, this brings attention to the people, audiences, collaborations, and shared futures you choose to belong to.

When this placement is supported, your place in a wider network can feel more meaningful and alive. Jupiter can become hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility.

When it is strained, belonging can become performative, or a future plan can outgrow the people attached to it. The harder pattern can show up as overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better.
gift: hope, confidence, perspective, generosity, and a larger sense of possibility expressed through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
challenge: overextension, excess, overpromising, or assuming more is always better around friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
